# or see flox-edit(1), manifest.toml(5) for more information.
#
# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.10.0"

# List packages you wish to install in your environment inside
# the `[install]` section.
[install]
# Python - Python itself is installed on activation via `uv sync`
uv = { pkg-path = "uv", pkg-group = "uv", version = "^0.11.14" }
xmlsec = { pkg-path = "xmlsec", version = "1.3.7" }
freetds = { pkg-path = "freetds" } # For pymssql
# Node
nodejs = { pkg-path = "nodejs_24", pkg-group = "nodejs", version = "24.13.0" } # Same maj.min ver as in Dockerfile; diverges from patch ver
# Set a lower priority on corepack so it takes precedence over nodejs (both bundle pnpm)
# https://flox.dev/docs/man/manifest.toml/#catalog-descriptors
corepack = { pkg-path = "corepack_24", pkg-group = "nodejs", version = "24.13.0", priority = 4 } # Same maj.min as in Dockerfile; diverges from patch ver
brotli = { pkg-path = "brotli", pkg-group = "nodejs" }
zstd = { pkg-path = "zstd", pkg-group = "nodejs" }
openssl = { pkg-path = "openssl", version = "3.4.1", pkg-group = "openssl", outputs = ["bin", "man", "dev", "out"] }
nodemon = { pkg-path = "nodemon" }
# Rust toolchain (based on https://flox.dev/docs/cookbook/languages/rust/)
cargo = { pkg-path = "cargo", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain", version = "1.91.1" }
rustc = { pkg-path = "rustc", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
clippy = { pkg-path = "clippy", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
rustfmt = { pkg-path = "rustfmt", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
rust-lib-src = { pkg-path = "rustPlatform.rustLibSrc", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
libiconv = { pkg-path = "libiconv", systems = ["aarch64-darwin"], pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
rust-analyzer = { pkg-path = "rust-analyzer", pkg-group = "rust-analyzer" } # rust-analyzer should be isolated in its own group, details in cookbook example
lld = { pkg-path = "lld", systems = ["aarch64-darwin"] } # Faster linker for Rust dev builds on macOS
sccache = { pkg-path = "sccache" } # Compilation cache for Rust (also used in CI)
# Go
go = { pkg-path = "go", version = "1.25.5", pkg-group = "go" }
golangci-lint = { pkg-path = "golangci-lint", pkg-group = "go" }
air = { pkg-path = "air" }
# CLI tools
git-lfs = { pkg-path = "git-lfs" }
ripgrep = { pkg-path = "ripgrep" }
mprocs = { pkg-path = "mprocs" }
util-linux = { pkg-path = "util-linux" } # flock
cmake = { pkg-path = "cmake", version = "3.31.5", pkg-group = "cmake" }
sqlx-cli = { pkg-path = "sqlx-cli", version = "0.8.3" } # sqlx
postgresql = { pkg-path = "postgresql_14" } # psql
ffmpeg = { pkg-path = "ffmpeg_5", version = "5.1.4", pkg-group = "ffmpeg" }
protobuf = { pkg-path = "protobuf" } # protoc compiler for gRPC code generation
ninja.pkg-path = "ninja"
emscripten = { pkg-path = "emscripten", pkg-group = "emscripten", version = "4.0.23" }
libpthread-stubs = { pkg-path = "libpthread-stubs", pkg-group = "emscripten" }
watchman = { pkg-path = "watchman" } # Fast file watching for Django/Celery autoreload (uses pywatchman)

# Set environment variables in the `[vars]` section. These variables may not
# reference one another, and are added to the environment without first
# expanding them. They are available for use in the `[profile]` and `[hook]`
# scripts.
[vars]
DEBUG = "1"
POSTHOG_SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECKS = "1"
FLAGS_REDIS_URL = "redis://localhost:6379/1"
# CH client default DB. Matches docker-compose convention — without it,
# Django queries unqualified `events` / `log_entries` etc. resolve against
# the literal `default` DB (where PostHog has no tables) and 500.
CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE = "posthog"
# HMAC secret the agent_stack preview-proxy shares with agent-ingress so
# the JWT minted by Django on every non-live invoke can be verified by
# ingress. Same value on both sides → live JWT round-trip. Dev only.
AGENT_PREVIEW_SECRET = "dev-agent-preview-secret-not-for-prod"
DIRENV_LOG_FORMAT = "" # Disable direnv activation logging (in case direnv is present)
RUST_LOG = "flox=error,flox_rust_sdk=error,flox_watchdog=error" # Suppress Flox logs only (also set in .envrc for early activation)
OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR = "$FLOX_ENV"
OPENSSL_LIB_DIR = "$FLOX_ENV/lib"
DOTENV_FILE = ".env"
OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR = "$FLOX_ENV/include"
LDFLAGS="-L$FLOX_ENV/lib"
CPPFLAGS="-I$FLOX_ENV/include"
RUSTC_WRAPPER = "sccache"
# UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT is set in the [hook]/[profile] scripts, not here: [vars]
# are added without expanding $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, so flox drops it on fresh activation.

# The `hook.on-activate` script is run by the *bash* shell immediately upon
# activating an environment, and will not be invoked if Flox detects that the
# environment has previously been activated. Variables set by the script will
# be inherited by `[profile]` scripts defined below. Note that any stdout
# generated by the script will be redirected to stderr.
[hook]
on-activate = '''
source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/.flox/env/on-activate.sh"
'''

# Scripts defined in the `[profile]` section are *sourced* by *your shell* and
# inherit environment variables set in the `[vars]` section and by `[hook]` scripts.
# The `profile.common` script is sourced by all shells and special care should be
# taken to ensure compatibility with all shells, after which exactly one of
# `profile.{bash,fish,tcsh,zsh}` is sourced by the corresponding shell.
[profile]
bash = '''
  if [ -f "$HOME/.bash_profile" ]; then
    source "$HOME/.bash_profile"
    # ensure even with your shell prefs in place we know this is a Flox.dev env
    export PS1="\033[47m(flox)\033[0m $PS1"
  fi
  unset GOROOT
  export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  export GOMODCACHE="$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  # Ensure flox binaries (especially Node.js) take precedence over system binaries
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV/bin:$PATH"
  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  # Recreate venv if it was deleted (on-activate only runs on first activation)
  if [ ! -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" ]; then
    uv sync
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  elif [ ! -L "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ] || [ ! -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]; then
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  fi
  source $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate
  # Source hogli bash completions
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/hogli.bash" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/hogli.bash"
  # Load phw worktree helper
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" >/dev/null
  # Route manually-run dependency installs (uv sync, pnpm install, ...) through the dev sandbox on macOS
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims"
'''
zsh = '''
  if [[ -f "$HOME/.zshrc" ]]; then
    source "$HOME/.zshrc"
    # ensure even with your shell prefs in place we know this is a Flox.dev env
    export PS1="%K{white}%F{black}(flox)%k%f $PS1"
  fi
  unset GOROOT
  export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  export GOMODCACHE="$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  # Ensure flox binaries (especially Node.js) take precedence over system binaries
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV/bin:$PATH"
  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  # Recreate venv if it was deleted (on-activate only runs on first activation)
  if [[ ! -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" ]]; then
    uv sync
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  elif [[ ! -L "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]] || [[ ! -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]]; then
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  fi

  autoload -Uz compinit && compinit -i

  [[ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" ]] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" >/dev/null

'''
fish = '''

  set -gx GOTOOLCHAIN local
  set -gx GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  set -gx GOCACHE "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  set -gx GOMODCACHE "$GOPATH/pkg/mod"

  end

tcsh = '''

  setenv GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"

runs.manifest:
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

# PostHog is a Python (uv) + Node (pnpm) monorepo. This root environment
# provides the shared runtimes for the main app (Django backend + frontend +
# plugin-server) and wires the dev-time datastores.
#
# Service disposition — "does a developer need this running locally to develop
# against?"  Postgres and Redis: yes (the app talks to them directly), so they
# are wired as native Flox [services.*], self-initializing, no Docker required.
# ClickHouse is runtime-oriented analytics infrastructure — its dev container
# mounts 5+ server config files (docker/clickhouse/config.xml, config.d/*,
# users-dev.xml, user_defined_function.xml + init scripts) and depends_on
# kafka + zookeeper, none of which a bare catalog package reproduces — so it is
# deferred WITH A MECHANISM to PostHog's own docker-compose stack (see [hook]),
# never silently dropped.
#
# The Go (livestream/, bin/hobby-installer, tools/phrocs) and Rust (rust/)
# services are separate sub-workspaces run as prebuilt images in the standard
# dev flow; floxify each one individually if you develop on it:
#   /floxify livestream   ·   /floxify rust

[install]
# Python 3.13.13 — pyproject.toml `requires-python = "==3.13.13"` (a hard
# equality, the one genuinely repo-demanded pin). The catalog version string
# carries a "python3-" prefix (`flox show python313`); pin the exact string it
# prints, not the bare semver, or the pin does not resolve.
python3.pkg-path = "python313"
python3.version = "python3-3.13.13"

# Node 24 — .nvmrc `v24.13.0`; package.json engines.node ">=24 <25".
# Left unpinned so it co-resolves with python313 in the shared toplevel group:
# the exact .nvmrc patch is not load-bearing (engines only floors at >=24) and
# the `nodejs_24` pkg-path already confines resolution to the 24.x line.
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"

# uv — uv.lock + pyproject.toml [tool.uv]; the Python package manager.
uv.pkg-path = "uv"

# corepack — provisions the exact pinned pnpm@10.29.3 (see [hook]). Installed
# explicitly (rather than relying on nodejs_24's bundled copy) and given a
# lower priority than nodejs so its binary wins any PATH collision.
corepack.pkg-path = "corepack_24"
corepack.priority = 4

# PostgreSQL 15 — docker-compose.base.yml `db` = postgres:15.12-alpine.
# Supplies initdb/postgres/createdb/pg_isready for [services.postgres].
# Unpinned (patch matched the compose image, not a hard requirement; the
# pkg-path confines resolution to the 15.x line). `outputs` exposes
# libpq/pg_config for anyone building against them.
postgresql.pkg-path = "postgresql_15"
postgresql.outputs = ["out", "lib", "dev"]

# Redis 7.2 — docker-compose.base.yml `redis7` = redis:7.2-alpine.
# Supplies redis-server for [services.redis]. Pinned + isolated in its own
# pkg-group: 2026-07-17 `flox activate` confirmed no catalog page carrying
# python313@python3-3.13.13 also carries redis 7.x (only 8.x — current latest
# is 8.8.0). Unpinning to co-resolve would silently jump Redis to a major
# version PostHog is not verified against. Redis has no native-linkage coupling
# to anything here (its Python client ships prebuilt wheels), so isolating it
# forfeits nothing beyond its own catalog-page download.
redis.pkg-path = "redis"
redis.version = "7.2.7"
redis.pkg-group = "redis-72"

# docker-compose — launcher for the deferred ClickHouse stack (see [hook]).
docker-compose.pkg-path = "docker-compose"

[vars]
# Dev-only credentials mirror docker-compose.base.yml `db`
# (POSTGRES_USER/DB/PASSWORD = posthog). [vars] are literal strings — dynamic,
# $-expanded values live in [hook]/[profile] instead.
PGUSER = "posthog"
PGDATABASE = "posthog"
PGPASSWORD = "posthog"
PGHOST = "/tmp"
PGPORT = "5432"
REDIS_PORT = "6379"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Python: uv-managed venv under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE (never ./venv) ---
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  uv sync --frozen || uv sync

  # --- Node: corepack activates the pinned pnpm@10.29.3 into a writable cache
  #     dir (the Nix nodejs store path is read-only). One root `pnpm install`
  #     covers all 54 pnpm-workspace.yaml packages. ---
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

  # --- ClickHouse: deferred-with-mechanism to PostHog's own configured compose
  #     service, which also pulls kafka + zookeeper via depends_on. Only started
  #     when a Docker daemon is reachable. COMPOSE_FILE (not an inline `-f`)
  #     keeps this a plain `docker-compose up`. ---
  if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export COMPOSE_FILE="docker-compose.dev.yml"
    docker-compose up -d clickhouse
  else
    echo "[flox] Docker not reachable — ClickHouse not started." >&2
    echo "[flox] Run: COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.dev.yml docker-compose up -d clickhouse" >&2
  fi
'''

[profile]
common = '''
  # Re-activate the uv venv and expose the pnpm shim on every shell entry.
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && \
    source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
'''

[services.postgres]
# Data under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, socket in /tmp, trust auth (dev only — not safe
# for shared machines). Creates the `posthog` database on first start.
command = '''
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" -U "$PGUSER" --auth=trust >/dev/null
  fi
  postgres -D "$PGDATA" -k /tmp -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" &
  pg_pid=$!
  until pg_isready -h /tmp -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 0.5
  done
  createdb -h /tmp -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$pg_pid"
'''

[services.redis]
# Data under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, socket in /tmp; mirrors compose maxmemory config.
# Dev cache/queue backend — matches docker-compose.base.yml redis7 settings.
command = '''
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"
  exec redis-server \
    --port "$REDIS_PORT" \
    --unixsocket /tmp/posthog-redis.sock \
    --maxmemory 200mb \
    --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru \
    --dir "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"
'''

[options]
# x86_64-darwin dropped: at latest, uv, nodejs_24, corepack_24, and
# docker-compose all lack an x86_64-darwin build (confirmed via `flox show`,
# 2026-07-17). uv installs every Python dependency and docker-compose brings up
# ClickHouse, so the env cannot activate on Intel macOS regardless — the
# interpreter itself (python3-3.13.13) does have an x86_64-darwin build.
systems = ["x86_64-linux", "aarch64-linux", "aarch64-darwin"]

schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify
#
# PostHog is a Python (uv) + Node (pnpm monorepo) + Go app. Its documented
# dev model (docs/.../developing-locally.md) is a hybrid: `flox activate`
# provides the host toolchain, then `hogli start` runs the app processes and
# the external-service Docker stack. This manifest is that host toolchain.
#
# Service disposition — postgres and redis are dev-time datastores a developer
# talks to directly, so they're wired as self-initializing Flox services (no
# Docker needed). ClickHouse (plus the Kafka/ZooKeeper it depends_on) is
# runtime-oriented analytics infrastructure with bespoke server config a bare
# catalog package can't reproduce; it's deferred WITH A MECHANISM to PostHog's
# own docker-compose stack in [hook] — never silently dropped.

[install]
# Pkg-group economy (2026-07-17): one shared toplevel group holds every
# package except redis. Confirmed live via `flox activate -c "echo __ok__"`
# on x86_64-linux — python313 (exact pin), nodejs_24, corepack_24, go_1_25,
# postgresql_15, uv, and docker-compose co-resolve together and activate
# cleanly (resolved to nodejs_24@24.16.0, corepack_24@24.16.0, go_1_25@1.25.11,
# postgresql_15@15.18). Redis is the one holdout — see its group comment below.

# Python 3.13.13 — pyproject.toml `requires-python = "==3.13.13"` (a hard
# equality, the one genuinely repo-demanded exact constraint; no
# .python-version/.tool-versions exists — the pin lives only here). The
# catalog's version string carries a "python3-" prefix (confirmed via
# `flox show python313`) — pin the exact string it prints, not the bare
# semver, or the pin does not resolve. Kept exact as the group's anchor.
python3.pkg-path = "python313"
python3.version = "python3-3.13.13"

# Node 24 — .nvmrc `v24.13.0`; package.json engines.node ">=24 <25". Unpinned:
# the exact patch matched .nvmrc but isn't load-bearing (engines only floors at
# >=24), and the pkg-path already confines resolution to the 24.x line.
# Resolved live to nodejs_24@24.16.0 (2026-07-17).
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"

# uv — uv.lock present; pyproject.toml [tool.uv] + [tool.uv.workspace]. The
# Python package manager; runs `uv sync` on activate (see [hook]).
uv.pkg-path = "uv"

# corepack — installed explicitly (lower priority than nodejs_24's bundled
# copy) so the pinned `packageManager = "pnpm@10.29.3"` is provisioned by a
# known corepack rather than whatever ships inside the nodejs derivation.
# Unpinned: its job (activating the exact pnpm pin) is version-independent.
corepack.pkg-path = "corepack_24"
corepack.priority = 4

# Go 1.25 — .github/workflows/*.yml setup-go `1.25.5`; go.mod directives in
# livestream/, bin/hobby-installer/, tools/phrocs/. Unpinned: go.mod's `go`
# directive is a floor, and the pkg-path already confines resolution to the
# 1.25.x line. Resolved live to go_1_25@1.25.11 (2026-07-17), ≥ the 1.25.5 floor.
go.pkg-path = "go_1_25"

# PostgreSQL 15 server+client — docker-compose.base.yml `db` = postgres:15.12-alpine.
# Provides initdb/postgres/createdb/pg_isready for [services.postgres]. Unpinned:
# the compose patch isn't a repo requirement; pkg-path confines to the 15.x line.
# outputs adds lib+dev (default is out+man) — exposes libpq/pg_config for anyone
# building a native pg client, though PostHog's psycopg[binary] ships its own.
postgresql.pkg-path = "postgresql_15"
postgresql.outputs = ["out", "lib", "dev"]

# Redis 7.2 server — docker-compose.base.yml `redis7` = redis:7.2-alpine.
# Provides redis-server for [services.redis]. Isolated in its own group
# (escalation ladder LAST rung): `flox activate` confirmed (2026-07-17) that no
# catalog page carrying python313@python3-3.13.13 also carries redis 7.x — only
# 8.x. Unpinning to co-resolve would silently jump redis to 8.x, away from what
# PostHog (redis:7.2-alpine) runs; kept exact and isolated instead. Redis has no
# native-linkage coupling to anything here (its Python client ships prebuilt
# wheels), so isolation forfeits nothing but its own catalog-page download.
redis.pkg-path = "redis"
redis.version = "7.2.7"
redis.pkg-group = "redis-72"

# docker-compose — launcher for the deferred-with-mechanism ClickHouse stack
# (pulls kafka + zookeeper via depends_on). See [hook].
docker-compose.pkg-path = "docker-compose"

[vars]
# Dev-only credentials mirror docker-compose.base.yml (posthog/posthog/posthog),
# consumed by [services.postgres]. Literal strings only — $FLOX_ENV_CACHE-based
# paths (venv, go cache) are exported with expansion in [hook]/[profile] instead.
PGUSER = "posthog"
PGDATABASE = "posthog"
PGPASSWORD = "posthog"
PGHOST = "/tmp"
PGPORT = "5432"
REDIS_PORT = "6379"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Python: uv-managed venv under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE (never ./venv). Refreshed
  #     every activation — uv sync is fast and keeps deps matching uv.lock. ---
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  uv sync --frozen || uv sync

  # --- Node: corepack activates the pinned pnpm@10.29.3 into a writable cache
  #     dir (the Nix nodejs store path is read-only). A single root install
  #     covers every pnpm-workspace.yaml package. Installed only when absent,
  #     matching PostHog's documented behavior. ---
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  [ -d node_modules ] || pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

  # --- Go: keep module/build caches under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, out of $HOME and the
  #     repo tree (livestream/, bin/hobby-installer/, tools/phrocs/). Deps are
  #     fetched by each service's own `go build`, not auto-installed here. ---
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOMODCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/pkg/mod"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/cache"
  mkdir -p "$GOMODCACHE" "$GOCACHE"

  # --- ClickHouse (+ its kafka/zookeeper deps): deferred to PostHog's own
  #     configured compose service — it mounts server config + init scripts a
  #     bare catalog package can't reproduce. Started only when Docker is
  #     reachable. Bare `docker-compose up` via COMPOSE_FILE (idempotent — a
  #     later `hogli start` reconciles with it). ---
  if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export COMPOSE_FILE="docker-compose.dev.yml"
    docker-compose up -d clickhouse
  else
    echo "[flox] Docker not reachable — ClickHouse not started." >&2
    echo "[flox] Run: COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.dev.yml docker-compose up -d clickhouse" >&2
  fi
'''

[profile]
common = '''
  # Re-activate the uv venv and re-expose the pnpm shim + Go bin on every shell
  # entry (hook exports don't persist into the interactive shell).
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && \
    source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export PATH="$GOPATH/bin:$PATH"
'''

[services.postgres]
# Data under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, socket in /tmp, trust auth (dev only). The app
# reaches this via the `db` hostname mapped to 127.0.0.1 in /etc/hosts.
command = '''
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" -U "$PGUSER" --auth=trust >/dev/null
  fi
  postgres -D "$PGDATA" -k /tmp -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" &
  pg_pid=$!
  until pg_isready -h /tmp -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 0.5
  done
  createdb -h /tmp -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$pg_pid"
'''

[services.redis]
# Data under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, socket in /tmp; mirrors compose maxmemory config.
# Reached via the `redis7` hostname mapped to 127.0.0.1 in /etc/hosts.
command = '''
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"
  exec redis-server \
    --port "$REDIS_PORT" \
    --unixsocket /tmp/posthog-redis.sock \
    --maxmemory 200mb \
    --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru \
    --dir "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"
'''

[options]
# x86_64-darwin excluded: at latest, uv, docker-compose, nodejs_24, corepack_24,
# and go_1_25 all lack an x86_64-darwin build (confirmed via `flox show`). uv

# python313@python3-3.13.13 and postgresql_15 themselves DO have x86_64-darwin
# builds — it's the toolchain around them that blocks that platform.
systems = ["x86_64-linux", "aarch64-linux", "aarch64-darwin"]

[profile]
common = '''
  # Re-activate the uv venv and expose the pnpm shim + Go bin dir on shell entry.
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && \
    source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export PATH="$GOPATH/bin:$PATH"
'''

[services.postgres]
# Data under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, socket in /tmp, trust auth (dev only).
command = '''
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" -U "$PGUSER" --auth=trust >/dev/null
  fi
  postgres -D "$PGDATA" -k /tmp -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" &
  pg_pid=$!
  until pg_isready -h /tmp -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 0.5
  done
  createdb -h /tmp -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$pg_pid"
'''

[services.redis]
# Data under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, socket in /tmp; mirrors compose maxmemory config.
command = '''
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"
  exec redis-server \
    --port "$REDIS_PORT" \
    --unixsocket /tmp/posthog-redis.sock \
    --maxmemory 200mb \
    --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru \
    --dir "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"
'''

# corepack_24 and go_1_25 all lack an x86_64-darwin build (confirmed live via

# Generated by /floxify

# PostHog is a Python (uv) + Node (pnpm monorepo) + Go app. Postgres and Redis
# are dev-time datastores — a developer needs them running locally to develop
# against — so they're wired as native, self-initializing Flox services (no
# Docker required). ClickHouse (plus the Kafka/ZooKeeper it depends_on) is
# runtime-oriented analytics infrastructure with bespoke server config and
# service coupling a bare catalog package can't reproduce; it's deferred WITH A
# MECHANISM to PostHog's own docker-compose stack (see [hook]), never silently

[install]
# Pkg-group economy: python313 carries the only hard, repo-demanded pin
# (`requires-python = "==3.13.13"`, an equality, not a floor). nodejs_24,
# corepack_24, postgresql_15, go_1_25, uv and docker-compose are left unpinned
# so they co-resolve with python313 in the single shared `toplevel` group —
# each pkg-path already confines resolution to its own major line. Confirmed
# live 2026-07-17 via `flox activate -c "echo __ok__"`. Redis is the one
# holdout that needs its own group — see its comment below.

# Python 3.13.13 — pyproject.toml `requires-python = "==3.13.13"` (hard
# equality). The catalog version string carries a "python3-" prefix (confirmed
# via `flox show python313`) — pin the exact string it prints, not the bare
# semver, or the pin does not resolve. Kept exact: the one repo-demanded pin,
# and the toolchain anchor for the shared group.
python3.pkg-path = "python313"
python3.version = "python3-3.13.13"

# Node 24 — .nvmrc `v24.13.0`; package.json engines.node ">=24 <25". Unpinned:
# the exact patch matched .nvmrc but isn't load-bearing (engines only floors at

# Go 1.25 — 3× go.mod `go 1.25.5` (livestream, bin/hobby-installer,

go.pkg-path = "go_1_25"
